nodes.label: CSS-first configuration with @theme
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v4 configures the theme in CSS with @theme, so a separate tailwind.config.js file is not needed.

nodes.label: Gap utilities for sibling spacing
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use gap instead of margins between siblings to reduce repetition and keep spacing consistent.

nodes.label: Consistency first
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Repeated project patterns are conventions and take precedence over the skill; existing tests that follow a convention should not be deleted or rewritten.

nodes.label: PHPUnit as the project test framework
nodes.author: laravel

nodes.label: Assert a known value
nodes.rationale: The expected value must be written in the test or computed differently; computing it with the implementation logic makes the test pass even when that logic is wrong.

nodes.label: Assert the complete result of a write operation
Tenant isolation status codes
nodes.rationale: Use 404 instead of 403 for cross-tenant requests because 403 confirms that another tenant's record exists.

nodes.label: Policy-level authorization testing
nodes.rationale: An HTTP test cannot identify which mechanism refused a request, since middleware, a policy, and abort() can all return 403; the full permission matrix belongs in a policy or gate test.

nodes.label: How to find test framework features
Built-in Laravel assertion methods
nodes.rationale: A hand-built check reports only 'false is not true', while a framework assertion names the incorrect table, value, or response.

nodes.label: LazilyRefreshDatabase over RefreshDatabase
nodes.rationale: A test that does not use the database then does not run the migrations.

nodes.label: Unexpected key in payload or configuration
Each test makes its own data
nodes.rationale: Mutable records belong inside each test or a helper that test calls so the setup stays visible; setUp() objects remain in memory until the suite ends.

nodes.label: Back-button and bfcache login fix
nodes.rationale: Back after login reached the login page and stale cached admin dashboard because login was reachable while authenticated and the browser bfcache restored pages; fixed with guest middleware, no-store headers, pageshow reload, session regeneration, POST logout, and role-aware redirects.
